evals.prompt: Draft a pending review on the PR for my current branch. Add a RIGHT-side inline comment on src/cache.py line 88 with two paragraphs. Keep it editable and do not publish it.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the current repo and PR, validates the live head and diff anchor, checks for an existing authenticated-user pending review, creates one review without event, verifies it remotely, and reports the Files changed URL and unpublished state.
expectations: The workflow does not guess the repository, PR, head SHA, path, or anchor.
The workflow checks for an existing authenticated-user PENDING review before POSTing.
The request contains an inline comments array and omits event.
The two paragraphs are encoded from real newline characters through jq rather than literal backslash-n text.
The result is verified through both the reviews endpoint and the review comments endpoint.
The response states that nothing was published and gives the Files changed URL.

evals.prompt: Put these review notes into an editable GitHub review, but I may already have a pending review on that PR. If so, don't create duplicates or remove anything without asking me.
evals.expected_output: The agent fails closed when it finds a pre-existing pending review and asks the user whether to keep or explicitly replace it; it performs no mutation before that decision.
expectations: The workflow identifies pending reviews by exact authenticated login and PENDING state.
A pre-existing pending review blocks creation.
The workflow never silently deletes or replaces a pre-existing or other-user review.
No submit, approve, request-changes, or publish action occurs.

evals.prompt: Create a draft PR review with three inline comments. If gh's output formatter errors after creation, retry it. Also fix any malformed draft comment using PATCH.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses unsafe blind retries, reconciles remote state after output failures, does not treat a missing response comments field as failure, and uses verified delete-and-recreate only for a newly-created current-invocation pending review if PATCH is unavailable.
expectations: A jq or formatting failure after POST does not cause an immediate second POST.
The raw create response is captured before projections and missing .comments is not treated as creation failure.
Remote reviews and review comments are inspected before retry or cleanup.
The workflow accounts for pending-comment PATCH returning 404.
Deletion is allowed only after proving the review is the authenticated user's newly-created PENDING review from this invocation.
Recreation revalidates the head SHA, anchors, pending-review state, bodies, and final remote state.
